reason: This document is a demerger circular for Melrose Industries PLC separating its GKN Automotive, GKN Powder Metallurgy, and GKN Hydrogen businesses (Dowlais Group) from GKN Aerospace (Continuing Melrose Group). The document focuses on the demerger mechanics, financial information, and shareholder voting procedures. It does not contain any company-disclosed Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures for either the Dowlais businesses or GKN Aerospace. The document includes market positioning statements (e.g., 'number one global drive system supplier,' 'content on approximately 50 per cent. of passenger vehicles,' 'global leader in sintered metal products') and references to third-party market data (S&P Global on EV penetration), but no specific TAM values disclosed by Melrose Industries itself.
